context_requirements: Functional Gq/PLC or Gi signaling downstream of HRH1
Presence of histamine or constitutive HRH1 activity to antagonize
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h across multiple cell lines

Consistent upregulation of immediate-early genes such as FOS or EGR1 at 6 h
